classification.difficultyReason: Students identify years zero and five as the endpoints and apply the average-rate formula directly to the supplied exponential model.

content.prompt:
The value of a car, in dollars, is modelled by the equation
$$V(t)=50000(1.15)^{-t},$$
where $t$ is time in years. What is the average rate of change in the value of the car over the first five years? Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Average rate}&=\frac{V(5)-V(0)}{5-0}\\\text{Average rate}&=\frac{50000(1.15)^{-5}-50000}{5}\\\text{Average rate}&\approx-5028.23.\end{align*}$$
The average rate of change is $-\$5028.23$ per year.
